_note: Four-legged animal text (wolf, dog, bear, sabre cat, horse, deer, elk, goat, cow, mammoth, horker, fox, hare, skeever, boar) for every source without its own file in this folder: fur or hide, legs and haunches, tail; bleeds like any beast. Words fit thick fur, short coat and bare hide alike. Shared keys first, then the block of the source's model (health / torture). Sources in skip keep humanoid text (drowning: lungs are lungs). Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.
